Container.Overview: mediaMender maintains Plex media libraries and provides metadata health, timestamp repair, and scheduled library refresh workflows. Configure it through the built-in web setup wizard.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the mediaMender web interface and setup wizard.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent mediaMender configuration, state, and logs.

Config.Name: Symlink Media Root
Config.Description: Root containing symlink media. Use slave propagation so FUSE mounts remain visible.

Config.Name: Physical Media Root
Config.Description: Optional root containing physical media files.

Config.Name: Plex Databases (local server 1)
Config.Description: Optional read-only Plex database directory for local timestamp repair.

Config.Name: Plex Databases (local server 2)
Config.Description: Optional second local Plex database directory.

Config.Name: Web UI Username (optional)
Config.Description: Optional web UI username override.

Config.Name: Web UI Password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional web UI password override.

Config.Name: API Token Override (optional)
Config.Description: Optional deployment-managed API token.

Config.Name: Real-Debrid API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional provider key override.

Config.Name: AllDebrid API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional provider key override.

Config.Name: Torbox API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional provider key override.

Config.Name: Debrid-Link API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional provider key override.

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional notification override.

Config.Name: Sonarr Main URL (optional)
Config.Description: URL paired with the Main Sonarr API key.

Config.Name: Sonarr Main API Key (optional)
Config.Description: API key used only for the matching Main Sonarr URL.

Config.Name: Sonarr Unlimited URL (optional)
Config.Description: URL paired with the Unlimited Sonarr API key.

Config.Name: Sonarr Unlimited API Key (optional)
Config.Description: API key used only for the matching Unlimited Sonarr URL.

Config.Name: Sonarr Anime URL (optional)
Config.Description: URL paired with the Anime Sonarr API key.

Config.Name: Sonarr Anime API Key (optional)
Config.Description: API key used only for the matching Anime Sonarr URL.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID; use 99 on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID; use 100 on Unraid.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone for schedules.
